cross_database_cautions: dbAMP_11661 has unsupported/contradictory MIC values and an unsupported Klebsiella pneumoniae target; retained as source_conflict.
DRAMP18140 activity and sequence are source-supported, but its missing toxicity metadata and PDB identifier mismatch are preserved as source_conflict cautions.
DBAASP hemolysis exact-value wording is stronger than the primary figure supports; final toxicity uses a source-bounded range.

unrecoverable_material_gaps.why_unrecoverable: Figure 5 provides bar plots for hemolysis and HT1080 viability, but no source table with exact per-concentration numeric values is present in the local XML, PDF text, or supplementary DOC. The repair records source-supported visual ranges rather than fabricated exact values.
unrecoverable_material_gaps.impact: Nonblocking caution: toxicity conclusion is source-supported as non-hemolytic/non-cytotoxic within tested ranges, but exact bar heights are not claimed.

unrecoverable_material_gaps.why_unrecoverable: The landing-*.bin files are duplicate HTML landing pages, not separate data tables. The recoverable supplementary content is the local Word supplement plus OA package figures.
unrecoverable_material_gaps.impact: Nonblocking material note; does not remove any source-supported activity/database/mechanism value.
